newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA INNOVEST SELLS AIR FIRM STAKE.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA INNOVEST SELLS AIR FIRM STAKE.

text.p: Malaysian timber and construction firm Innovest Bhd said on Wednesday it would sell its entire 81.8 percent stake in air transport company Trans Pacific Air Sdn Bhd.
The stake would be sold to one of Trans Pacific's directors for 3.15 million ringgit in cash, said Innovest in a statement.
Innovest also said it had bought an 80 percent stake in property developer Euro Astro Development Sdn Bhd. Euro Astro has a paid-up capital of two million ringgit, said Innovest.
Innovest shares were suspended from trading earlier in the day. They were last traded at 7.80 ringgit.
